name: team-memory-harness
description: Shared, evidence-backed engineering lessons for independent Pi agents.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n api,dashboard -c green,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.test: tsx --test apps/api/src/*.test.ts apps/dashboard/preview/*.test.ts apps/evaluator/src/*.test.ts apps/mcp/src/*.test.ts packages/contracts/src/*.test.ts packages/pi-extension/src/*.test.ts skills/team-memory/scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace @team-memory/dashboard
scripts.check: npm run skills:check && npm run test && npm run build && npm run mcp:build && npm run plugin:check
